scenario.summary: Guest opens a category PLP by its route, shows the full page (page size 32), sorts Name A-Z and Name Z-A and checks the rendered window is in ascending, then descending order and that the first product differs between the two sorts. Read-only.
steps: Open the category route as a guest; check the heading contains the category name.
Set page size 32 and wait for at least minimumRenderedProducts product names.
Select sort 5 (Name A-Z); poll until the rendered names are in ascending order.
Select sort 6 (Name Z-A); poll until the rendered names are in descending order.
Check the first A-Z name differs from the first Z-A name.
assertions: Category heading contains the category name.
At least 2 product names render; A-Z window ascending, Z-A window descending (case-insensitive).
First product differs between A-Z and Z-A.
